name: Wei Jian Hao
bio:
Wei Jian Hao's passion for motorsport ignited during his teenage years, fueled by the roar of Formula 1 cars echoing through the Singapore Grand Prix. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the National University of Singapore, focusing on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduation, Wei began his career as a junior engineer at a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and innovative problem-solving abilities.

He joined Toyota Gazoo Racing five years ago as a senior engineer, impressing management with his meticulous approach to data analysis and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies. Wei's appointment as Technical Director is a testament to his dedication and talent. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers are empowered to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of performance. Wei is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, which allows him to make critical decisions with clarity and precision, even in the heat of competition.
